title: Coefficient Target Section Generators
statement: Let f:X -> T be separated [def-pc-morphism-conventions], F a quasi-coherent O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], U an affine open of T, and Z an affine open of Y=f inverse image U. Let g:Tprime -> U, gprime:Xprime -> X, fprime:Xprime -> Tprime form a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product] with f and g followed by U. Let W=gprime inverse image of the image of Z in X and B an affine open of Tprime. Put A=Gamma(U,O), R=Gamma(B,O), N=Gamma(Z,F|Y) with the A-action of [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model], and M=gprime^*F [def-pc-module-pullback]. Put I=W intersect fprime inverse image B and u(s)=the restriction to I of coefficientPullbackGenerator F Y Z gprime W hW s [lem-pc-finite-affine-cech-coefficient-comparison-map]. Every y in Gamma(I,M) has an expression y=sum_{i in Fin n} a_i*u(s_i), for some natural number n, a_i in Gamma(I,O), and s_i in N.

proof.text: The affine intersection base-change theorem gives that W -> Tprime is affine. Pull back the affine open B to W, then take its image under the open immersion W -> Xprime. The image-preimage identity identifies this affine open with I = W intersect fprime inverse image B. The open V = Y.ι(Z) is affine by preservation of affine opens under open immersions.

Apply exists_tensorPullback_affine_sections to gprime, the affine source open V and affine target open I, with I <= gprime inverse image V following from hW. Use the surjectivity and pure-tensor formula of its comparison c for F.

Compare tensorPullback gprime with pullback gprime via Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq and use unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app. Naturality of the comparison with restriction transports the pure-tensor formula to the standard pullback. The inverse of F.restrictAppIso identifies a section on V with a section on Z; the inverse-hom identity and composition of restrictions identify its generator with coefficientPullbackGenerator restricted to I. Take a tensor preimage of the inverse-comparison image of y. Tensor induction gives the desired finite sums: the zero case uses Fin 0, a pure tensor uses Fin 1, and addition concatenates the coefficient and source-section families with Fin.addCases. Fin.sum_univ_add verifies the sum equation.

proof_origin.note: S4: direct transport by uniqueness of left adjoints, restriction section isomorphism, and tensor induction; no open-immersion pullback comparison needed.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientTarget_section_generators
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) [IsSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : T.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (Z : (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) (hZ : IsAffineOpen Z)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι))
    (W : X'.Opens) (hW : W = g' ⁻¹ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ Z))
    (B : T'.Opens) (hB : IsAffineOpen B) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤) Γ(T', B) :=
      (g.appLE ⊤ B (by simp)).hom.toAlgebra
    let N := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)).inv ≫
        ((f ∣_ U) ≫ U.toScheme.toSpecΓ).appTop).hom)).obj
          ((F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).presheafModuleCat.obj (op Z))
    let M := (pullback g').obj F
    ∀ y : Γ(M, W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B),
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → Γ(X', W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B)) (s : Fin n → N),
        y = ∑ i, a i •
          (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B ≤ W)).op
            (coefficientPullbackGenerator F (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) Z g' W hW (s i)))
